config.purpose: Ten-seed evaluation against AttentionBoost using the expanded official 25-image training, 11-image Huh7 test, and 25-image HepG2 test partitions.
config.augmentation: Uniform 90-degree rotations and independent horizontal and vertical flips with probability 0.5.
config.selection: Fixed final epoch; contact threshold and minimum instance size selected using official training images only; test images decoded once.
config.primary_endpoint: Bilkent nucleus-level micro F1, reported separately for Huh7 and HepG2.
config.published_comparator: AttentionBoost: Huh7 F1 0.954 +/- 0.005; HepG2 F1 0.919 +/- 0.008 over five runs.
